name: @ai-crew-suite/temporal-container
description: Decoupled custom temporal-server compiled from source with integrated temporal-sql-tool migrations

scripts.build: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image build temporal-container
scripts.lint: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image lint temporal-container
scripts.image:test:security: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image test security temporal-container
scripts.image:test:structure: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image test structure temporal-container
scripts.publish: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image publish temporal-container
scripts.test: yarn image:test:security && yarn image:test:structure && yarn test:unit
